I. GENERAL ELUCIDATION.
The purpose of the establishment of the State is stated in the fourth paragraph of the Preamble of the 1945 Constitution of the Republic of Indonesia which states that "The State protects all Indonesian people and all Indonesian territory and to promote general welfare, educate the life of the nation and participate in implementing world order based on independence, eternal peace and social justice". The meaning of protecting here includes protecting every citizen including from all forms of violence. Furthermore, in Article 28 G paragraph 2 of the 1945 Constitution it states that every person has the right to be free from torture or treatment that degrades human dignity. Thus the right to obtain protection from acts of violence is guaranteed by the constitution.
Acts of violence against women and children constitute violations of human rights. Women and children victims of violence must have their dignity and honor protected and their right to life guaranteed in accordance with their nature without discrimination. In order to prevent and overcome violence against women and children in Buleleng Regency, it is necessary to provide protection for women and children victims of violence in the form of Regional Regulation.
Protection of women and children victims of violence in the Region requires institutional and regulatory support that can guarantee its implementation. The Regional Regulation regulates protection efforts for victims specifically in terms of prevention, services, and empowerment of women and children victims of violence in Buleleng Regency.

1.8.rationale: In the Indonesian source, the regulation’s substantive scope of violence is defined in Pasal 5 (kekerasan fisik, seksual, ekonomi, sosial, psikis, penelantaran rumah tangga, pemaksaan/perampasan kemerdekaan, ancaman tindakan tertentu). It does not list “perdagangan orang/trafficking” as a form of violence covered by the regulation’s scope. The only place trafficking appears is in the legal bases (“Mengingat”): UU No. 21 Tahun 2007 tentang Pemberantasan Tindak Pidana Perdagangan Orang and PP No. 9 Tahun 2008 on integrated services for trafficking victims, plus Pasal 13(1)h mentions children victims of “penculikan, penjualan, dan/atau perdagangan” under special protection categories. Merely citing a referenced law in the preamble is not sufficient to conclude the policy includes human trafficking within its scope indicator (as framed here). The judge over-relied on the ‘Mengingat’ citation and treated it as substantive inclusion, so this is an evaluation/interpretation error rather than missing evidence.

Article 5
Letter a What is meant by "physical violence" is any act that results in pain, injury, wounds or disability to a person's body, miscarriage, loss of consciousness and or causes death Letter b What is meant by "sexual violence" is any act in the form of sexual harassment, forced sexual relations, forced sexual relations with another person for commercial purposes and or certain purposes.
Letter c What is meant by "economic violence" is an action that restricts humans from working inside or outside the home to produce money and goods, including allowing humans who work to be exploited, while someone does not fulfill the economic needs of the family.
Letter d What is meant by "social violence" is an act of a person or group of people that causes injury or loss of life of a person or can cause physical damage or damage to another person's property Letter e What is meant by "psychological violence" is an act that results in fear, loss of self-confidence, loss of ability to act, feelings of helplessness and or severe psychological suffering to a person.
Letter f What is meant by "Domestic Neglect" is:
a. actions that result in the failure to fulfill the needs of children properly, whether physical, mental, spiritual or social;
b. actions of deliberately neglecting to maintain, care for, or take care of children as they should be;

18. Service is an action taken as soon as possible to the victim when seeing, hearing and knowing that violence against the victim will, is or has occurred.
